description: S462 (dpa-069 item 7): the sink pins of `undeclared-attr-on-attr-lift-listener-pos`, moved onto PLAIN elements. In `lift` / `<each>` markup an attribute spelled `onClick` on a body-authored `<button>` is wired as a `click` listener — never written as handler text; a URL attribute (`href=it.url`) is written through the runtime guard; a non-sink attribute (`title=it.t`) is written. Under O18 (RULED S462, SPEC §66.6.9) no §66 use-site attribute reaches an element, so every executable sink is an attribute an author wrote on an element like these; the component-route case stays for impl#1's legacy `const X = <…>` form through its §63 window.
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 (S457) event-handler text from data: "In `<each>` rows and `lift` markup every attribute rule 1's name test makes an event handler (any case, `on:x` included) is wired as a listener for the lowercased event name"; rule 3 guards the URL write. §66.6.9 rule 7 (S462): every executable sink in a §66 program is an attribute an author wrote in a body or a `renders`.
